title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 193
paragraphs: So they came for a second time and stationed their ships around Artemisium; and from that time to this they still use the title 'Savior' for Poseidon. Meanwhile, once the wind had ceased and the swell had calmed, the barbarians dragged their ships into the sea and sailed along the mainland shore. Having rounded the tip of Magnesia, they sailed straight into the gulf leading toward Pagasai. In this gulf of Magnesia there is a place where, it is said, Heracles was left behind by Jason and his comrades, having been sent from the Argo to fetch water, when they were sailing for the fleece to Aia in Colchis — for from that spot, once they had taken on water, they planned to launch their ship into the open sea. That is why the place is called Aphetai. Here, then, the fleet of Xerxes took up its moorings.
